meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 6 — Deeper provincial / archipelagic densification, tourism statistics, and investment (FDI) realization. Strengthens the spatial layer beyond the Java-core / outer-islands meta and adds tourism and capital-flow nodes.

candidates.title: Provincial administrative structure (38 provinces) and island counts
candidates.description: Official list and geographic statistics of Indonesia’s provinces (currently 38 after Papua splits), including land area and number of islands by province. Foundational spatial-frame node for all provincial series.
referenced_by: All PDRB, population and provincial statistical series
candidates.notes: Administrative backbone of the sub-national layer.

candidates.title: Sumatra regional statistical profile
candidates.description: Aggregate and key provincial statistics for the Sumatra island group — major palm-oil, coal, oil & gas and plantation economy; significant population and land area.

candidates.title: Kalimantan regional statistical profile
candidates.description: Statistics for the Kalimantan provinces — dominant coal, palm-oil, forestry and emerging industrial roles; large land area and low population density relative to Java.
referenced_by: New capital (IKN) related planning where relevant
candidates.notes: Core Borneo resource region; also site of the new capital project context.

candidates.title: Sulawesi regional statistical profile (nickel focus)
candidates.description: Statistics for Sulawesi provinces — central to the nickel mining and downstream processing boom, with significant agricultural and fisheries activity.
candidates.notes: Geographic anchor of the nickel downstreaming story.

candidates.title: Papua regional statistical profile (including new provinces)
candidates.description: Statistics for the Papua provinces — vast land area, low population density, resource potential (minerals, forest), distinctive demographic and development indicators, and recent administrative splitting into multiple provinces.
referenced_by: Provincial population, poverty and PDRB series
candidates.notes: Easternmost and most distinctive regional node; administrative structure still evolving.

candidates.title: Bali and Nusa Tenggara tourism-oriented regional profile
candidates.description: Statistics for Bali and the Nusa Tenggara provinces — tourism-heavy (especially Bali), distinctive cultural and demographic profiles, and different development challenges from the large resource islands.
candidates.notes: Tourism-specialised regional contrast to the resource outer islands.

candidates.title: Domestic Tourism Statistics (Wisatawan Nusantara)
candidates.description: Annual BPS publication on domestic tourism: visitor profiles, trip purpose, accommodation, duration and expenditure. Increasingly uses mobile-positioning and digital-survey methods.

candidates.title: Tourism attraction / object statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on tourism objects and attractions, their distribution, types (nature, cultural, man-made) and related revenue indicators. Highlights strong concentration in Java and Bali versus limited development in eastern regions.
referenced_by: Regional development and spatial inequality discussions
candidates.notes: Supply-side tourism node with clear spatial imbalance.

candidates.title: Foreign Direct Investment realization statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Investment / BKPM (published via BPS tables and official releases)
candidates.description: Official realization figures for foreign investment by country of origin, sector and (where published) location. Key capital-flow series complementary to the BOP financial account.
candidates.notes: Primary FDI realization node. Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Japan and others appear as major sources in recent data.

candidates.title: Domestic investment realization statistics
candidates.description: Counterpart statistics on domestic investment realization by sector and location. Completes the investment picture alongside FDI.

candidates.title: Indonesia provincial and archipelagic densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from BPS provincial series, tourism and investment statistics
candidates.description: Meta-node that records the densification of the sub-national layer: provincial structure, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi (nickel), Papua, Bali–Nusa Tenggara, domestic tourism, tourism attractions, FDI and domestic investment realization. Strengthens the spatial edges already seeded by the Java-core / outer-islands contrast.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier PDRB, Java-core, outer-islands and commodity nodes
candidates.notes: Book-keeping and integrating node for the deepened spatial layer.
